confusables.note: هم‌معنی «in spite of» است، اما بدون of به کار می‌رود: despite the rain نه despite of the rain.

homograph.note: The prepositional phrase "in spite of" (despite) and the noun spite (malice, a wish to hurt) are historically related but semantically far apart; a learner who knows one would not guess the other, so the card should show them as separate blocks.

senses.definition: in the phrase "in spite of myself" (or himself, herself): even though you did not intend or want it to happen

examples.en: In spite of myself, I laughed at his clumsy joke.
examples.fa: بی‌آنکه بخواهم، به شوخی دست‌وپاشکسته‌اش خندیدم.

senses.definition: used before a noun to say that something happens even though a condition might have prevented it

examples.en: In spite of the heavy rain, the match started on time.
examples.fa: با وجود باران شدید، مسابقه سر وقت شروع شد.

senses.definition: a feeling of wanting to hurt or annoy someone because you are angry with them

examples.en: He broke the vase out of spite after the argument.
examples.fa: پس از آن دعوا، از روی کینه گلدان را شکست.
